Low-Budget Film 'Hanu-man' Surpasses Expectations at Box Office

The film 'Hanu-man', made on a modest budget, has achieved significant box office success, defying initial expectations of being a flop. Despite a slow start, the movie's collections have surged, particularly in its fourth week. The film is reportedly outperforming 'Toxic', a movie with a larger budget and star cast, with attributed reasons including divine blessings and negative reviews for 'Toxic'.
